order: deterministic first (cheap, parallel); judges only if no hard deterministic fail

checks.pass: Output validates against contract.output_schema (ajv)
checks.remediation: Your output failed schema validation: {errors}. Return the same content as valid JSON matching the schema; fix only the listed paths.

checks.pass: Every string ≤ its maxLength / field limit
checks.remediation: '{field}' is {n} chars; limit {max}. Shorten to ≤{max} keeping the same message.

checks.pass: hook ≤125 (IG) / ≤210 (LinkedIn); total ≤2200 IG, ≤3000 LI, ≤150 rec TikTok, ≤280 X
checks.remediation: {platform} {part} is {n} chars (limit {max}). Cut to fit; keep the hook first.

checks.pass: No token/phrase from bio.voice.forbidden_words (case/accents-insensitive, word boundary, lemma list)
checks.remediation: '{word}' is on the brand's never-say list (BIO rule {rule_id}). Replace it with a word that keeps the meaning; do not use synonyms listed in the same rule.

checks.pass: No content matching message_spec.refusals / bio.refusals patterns (regex + keyword list per refusal)
checks.remediation: This output does what the brief refuses: '{refusal}'. Remove {evidence}.

checks.pass: No fake-urgency patterns (ES/EN list: 'solo hoy','última oportunidad','limited time','hurry','!!') unless brief has dated offer
checks.remediation: Fake urgency '{match}' is not allowed (no dated offer in the brief). Remove it or replace with the real time cue from the Message Spec ({cta}).

checks.pass: No 'best/#1/only/mejor/único' claims without proof id
checks.remediation: Unprovable superlative '{match}'. Remove it or replace with a specific fact from proof[].

checks.pass: Every number, date, place, price, named person/award in output appears in proof[] / bio.facts / brief (entity match) and proof_ids set
checks.remediation: '{entity}' isn't in the brand facts or brief. Remove it or use a fact from: {available_facts}.

checks.pass: No engagement bait patterns ('tag a friend','comenta SÍ') unless bio.voice.do allows
checks.remediation: Engagement bait '{match}' is off-policy. Replace with the CTA from the Message Spec.

checks.pass: emoji count ≤ bio.voice.emoji_policy.max (default 0 if policy=none)
checks.remediation: {n} emoji used; brand allows {max}. Remove extras.

checks.pass: hashtag count ≤ bio policy per platform; no banned tags
checks.remediation: {n} hashtags; limit {max}. Keep the most specific.

checks.pass: ES: LanguageTool/hunspell 0 errors on accents, ¿¡ pairing
checks.remediation: Spelling/orthography: {errors}. Fix only these.

checks.pass: No word ≥4 letters in ALL CAPS (except acronyms in BIO)
checks.remediation: Remove ALL CAPS from '{word}'.

checks.pass: No '!!', '??', or more than 1 '!' per item
checks.remediation: Reduce exclamation marks to at most one.

checks.pass: preheader ≠ subject (token Jaccard <0.6); headline variants Jaccard <0.8
checks.remediation: '{a}' and '{b}' are near-duplicates. Rewrite '{b}' with a different angle.

checks.pass: Required counts (messages 1–3, territories =3, headlines ≤20 in 4 buckets)
checks.remediation: Expected {expected} {item}; got {n}.

checks.pass: Top-5 dominant colours each within ΔE2000 ≤10 of a BIO palette colour or neutral (k-means)
checks.remediation: Colour {hex} ({pct}% of image) is off-palette. Regenerate with palette {palette_hex} and 'no {colour_name}'.

checks.pass: OCR(text) == overlay_text (normalized; accents must match)
checks.remediation: Rendered text reads '{ocr}', expected '{overlay_text}'. Regenerate with the exact string in quotes, or drop the overlay and let the renderer add it.

checks.pass: width×height matches platform spec
checks.remediation: Size {w}×{h}; required {spec}. Regenerate at {spec}.

checks.pass: No logo/wordmark detected unless supplied asset (vision OCR + logo detector)
checks.remediation: An invented logo/text mark appears. Regenerate with 'no logos, no text'.

checks.pass: Every image has alt 5–125 chars, not 'image of'
checks.remediation: Add alt text describing the image content (≤125 chars).

checks.pass: Renderer returns 0 errors (MJML strict), 0 unresolved tokens, screenshot non-blank, no horizontal overflow at 375px
checks.remediation: Render failed: {error}. Fix the block field {path}.

checks.pass: WCAG AA: text/bg contrast ≥4.5 (≥3 for ≥24px)
checks.remediation: Contrast {ratio} on '{selector}' < {min}. Use token {suggested}.

checks.pass: All hrefs absolute https, CTA url == message_spec.cta.url
checks.remediation: Link '{href}' invalid; use {cta.url}.

checks.pass: Every external claim has url+quote+fetched_at
checks.remediation: Claim '{claim}' lacks a source. Add one from the provided pages or remove it.

checks.pass: Sources ≤30 days old
checks.remediation: Source {url} is {age} days old; replace or drop.

checks.pass: Total duration within spec ±0.5s
checks.remediation: Duration {d}s; required {spec}s.

checks.pass: Judge (Haiku 5.5) scores voice 1–5 vs 3 BIO examples; pass ≥4 (demo ≥3)
checks.remediation: Voice drift: {evidence}. Match BIO example rhythm: {example_snippet}. Change {spans} only.

checks.pass: Judge scores 'answers goal & SMP' 1–5; pass ≥3
checks.remediation: The output doesn't carry message {message_id} / goal '{goal}'. Make {span} do that.

checks.pass: Judge: variants differ on declared axis, not just wording; pass yes
checks.remediation: Variants {a} and {b} are the same idea. Make {b} differ on {axis}.

checks.pass: Vision judge (Gemini 3.8 Flash) on screenshot: imagery rules, logo clear space, hierarchy, no artefacts; 1–5 pass ≥3
checks.remediation: Visual issue: {issue} at {region}. {fix}.

checks.pass: Image mood matches visual.imagery do/don't (1–5 ≥3)
checks.remediation: Image reads '{observed}', brand imagery is '{rule}'. Regenerate with {direction}.

checks.pass: Judge: every synthesized statement supported by quoted sources
checks.remediation: Unsupported statement '{s}'. Remove or cite.

checks.pass: Judge flags health/legal/comparative claims
checks.remediation: Possible regulated claim '{s}' → escalate to human; don't auto-fix.

checks.pass: Subject/key elements outside platform UI zones (IG story top/bottom 250px; reels right 120px), via saliency box
checks.remediation: Key content sits under platform UI at {region}. Regenerate with the subject inside the central safe area.

checks.pass: Declared headline_zone has low detail (edge density < threshold) and contrast allows white or ink text ≥4.5
checks.remediation: The headline zone {zone} is busy or low-contrast. Regenerate with clear negative space in that zone.

checks.pass: Series consistency: palette ΔE between images ≤12, same aspect/stroke rules
checks.remediation: Image {n} breaks the series ({diff}). Regenerate it with the series style: {style}.

checks.pass: All mandatory label fields present or explicitly [TO SUPPLY]
checks.remediation: Mandatory field(s) {fields} missing. Add from facts or mark [TO SUPPLY]; never invent.

checks.pass: OOH headline ≤7 words
checks.remediation: Headline has {n} words; OOH max 7. Cut to ≤7.

checks.pass: Overlay text area ≤20% of image (OCR boxes)
checks.remediation: Text covers {pct}% of the image. Reduce to ≤20% or drop the overlay.

checks.pass: Vision judge: product in output matches reference (shape, colour, label) ≥4/5
checks.remediation: Product differs from reference ({diff}). Regenerate in edit/reference mode keeping the product unchanged.

checks.pass: SVG parses; ≤ max paths; no raster <image>; colours ⊂ palette (+white/black)
checks.remediation: SVG invalid or off-rules: {error}. Regenerate as flat vector using {palette_hex}.

checks.pass: Vega-Lite spec validates (v5 schema) and every data value traces to data_sources
checks.remediation: Chart spec invalid or contains untraced values: {error}. Use only the supplied data.

checks.pass: Every claim/tension/segment item has a non-empty evidence field pointing to bio path or source
checks.remediation: '{item}' has no evidence. Add a BIO path or source, or remove it.

checks.pass: Each refusal has a bio_ref that exists in the BIO
checks.remediation: Refusal '{r}' cites no valid BIO field. Add one or drop it.

checks.pass: Channels ⊂ bio.channels unless flagged test:true
checks.remediation: Channel '{c}' isn't one the brand uses. Mark it as a test or remove it.

checks.pass: word_count within requested range and equals actual count
checks.remediation: Length {n} words; requested {range}.

checks.pass: Every quote is supplied in brief or marked [QUOTE TO CONFIRM]
checks.remediation: Quote '{q}' isn't supplied. Replace with [QUOTE TO CONFIRM].

checks.pass: Words per second ≤2.5 EN / ≤2.3 ES per cut
checks.remediation: {cut}s cut runs {wps} words/s. Cut to fit.

checks.pass: Merge tags ⊂ whitelist
checks.remediation: Unknown merge tag {tag}. Use only {whitelist}.

checks.pass: Tokens validate against W3C DTCG format; colours ⊂ palette or marked derived
checks.remediation: Token {path} invalid or off-palette. Fix per DTCG / mark derived.

checks.pass: Mermaid parses (mermaid-cli)
checks.remediation: Flow diagram doesn't parse: {error}.

checks.pass: Each verbatim is an exact substring of the uploaded data
checks.remediation: Verbatim '{v}' not found in the data. Use exact quotes only.
